verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe MCP integration: agents can query databases, integrate with APIs like Slack/GitHub, and connect to other services via MCP without custom tool implementations, plus an in-process MCP server for custom tool exposure. This directly delivers the story of plugging MCP servers in so Claude can use their tools. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of MCP server configuration in practice, and detail on connecting third-party external MCP servers (only in-process/custom examples shown).
